description: List public holidays (bank holidays, national holidays) for a country and year: 207 countries, 2000–2050. Use for holiday calendars, office closures and checking if a date is a holiday. Lunar or government-proclaimed dates are rule-based estimates. First 25 calls per day are free, then $0.001 per call (x402).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (207 countries); its public holidays (2000–2050) are excluded from business days

name: public_holidays

substitute.description: Observed on another day because the holiday falls on a weekend

title: Public holidays
